scenes.text:
The logo only
existed as a JPG.
scenes.caption: Artesano Cafeteria, brand identity, 2026. The logo only existed as a JPG.

scenes.text:
Rough edges.
A fake transparent
background.
scenes.sub: And wheat that turned into a smudge at small sizes.
scenes.caption: Starting point: rough edges, a fake transparent background, and wheat that turned into a smudge at small sizes.

scenes.text:
Clean up the old seal,
or start again?
scenes.sub: The café was new. There was no history to keep.
scenes.caption: The question: clean up the old seal, or start again? The café was new, so there was no history to keep.

scenes.sub: Symbol options generated with AI. I chose one and finished it by hand in Figma.
scenes.caption: The mark: wheat, a cup and three arcs. Symbol options generated with AI; I chose one and finished it by hand in Figma.
One signature, three uses: main, negative and symbol.

scenes.sub: So it prints in one color, even on kraft paper.
scenes.caption: Two colors: coffee brown and white, so it prints in one color, even on kraft paper.
Type: Garamond for the name, Montserrat for the rest.
scenes.sub: Garamond for the name, as the client asked. Montserrat for the descriptor and short labels.
Mockups generated with AI, for illustration only.
scenes.caption: Applications: cups, bags and boxes. Mockups generated with AI, for illustration only.

scenes.text:
Approved by the client
the next day.
scenes.sub: 14-page brand guide, 4 logo files, presentation film
scenes.caption: Approved by the client the next day. A 14-page brand guide, 4 logo files and a presentation film.
